verdict.rationale: Working Copy is an iOS Git client, not primarily a coding agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows no MCP server: its automation surfaces are x-callback-url, Shortcuts and a WebDAV server, which are adjacent integration points and do not count as MCP. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI also returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
